## About
L & E is a tire shop at 10124 Jensen Drive in Houston. We stock both new and used tires and rims, and we offer loans and payment plans to help you cover tires and auto repair expenses.
The shop is owned by Maria Martinez, along with a dedicated team.
We're rated 4.3 on Google from 34 reviews. Give us a call or swing by Monday through Saturday.

## Services
- New and Used Tires and Rims: We stock both new and used tires and rims, so you can pick what fits your car and your budget.
- Loans / Payment Plans: Payment plans to help you pay for auto repair expenses and tires, with instant easy approvals.
- Running boards installation: One reviewer had running boards installed on a Dodge Ram and recommends us for the job.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We stock both new and used tires and rims.

Q: Can I get a payment plan with bad credit?
A: Yes. Our payment plans are good to bad credit approved, across 5 credit tiers from A through E.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday. Come see us Monday through Saturday.
